name: Get to Know Me
description: A personal introductory website created to present information about myself using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

name: CPSC44000 Web Resume
description: A web-based resume created for CPSC44000 that presents my qualifications, technical skills, education, projects, research experience, and other professional information using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap. A printable PDF version of the resume is also included.

name: Web Dice Roller
description: A web-based dice roller created for CPSC44000 that simulates rolling five six-sided dice for the game of Yahtzee. The application automatically rolls the dice when the page loads and allows the user to roll all five dice again using a button or the Enter key.

name: Lions, Tigers & Bears
description: A JavaScript web application that uses an external API to retrieve and display animal-related information.
